# Calum Lill

Calum Lill is a British actor known for television and stage roles, notably portraying solicitor Joel Deering in the ITV soap opera Coronation Street between 2023 and 2024, with a brief return reported in 2025. His earlier screen work includes a guest role on BBC One’s Doctors and a recurring appearance in Channel 4’s Hollyoaks as PC Carlton Smith in 2021. Lill trained at Arts Educational Schools London (ArtsEd), earning a BA (Hons) in Acting in 2018, and has appeared on stage in Tim Whitnall’s The Sociable Plover at London’s Old Red Lion Theatre (May 2025) and as the pantomime villain Fleshcreep in Jack and the Beanstalk at Bournemouth Pavilion (December 2024–January 2025) and the Oak Theatre at Scarisbrick Hall (December 2025). His Coronation Street storyline—centred on Joel’s criminal behaviour and a subsequent whodunnit—attracted substantial coverage; he was among Coronation Street’s nominations highlighted for the Inside Soap Awards 2024, and his longlisting for British Soap Awards Villain of the Year was reported by regional media. Beyond acting, Lill’s public appearances have included participating with castmates in the AJ Bell Great Manchester Run. 

## Early life and education

Publicly available biographical details are limited, but professional profiles and interviews indicate that Lill trained at Arts Educational Schools London, graduating with a BA (Hons) in Acting in 2018. In interviews about his career, Lill has described the precarious nature of acting work and a period before Coronation Street when he considered leaving the profession due to financial pressures and a lack of roles. 

## Career

### Television

Lill’s television credits include:

- Doctors (BBC One): He appeared in Series 20 episode “Division,” playing Chez Wilson-Needham. 

- Holby City (BBC One): Radio Times listed Holby City among Lill’s prior credits; details of the specific episode are not widely published in mainstream sources accessible here. 

- Hollyoaks (Channel 4): Lill played PC Carlton Smith in 2021 in a recurring capacity. Contemporary reporting in reputable entertainment outlets noted the character’s involvement in a storyline connected to the death of George Kiss. 

- Coronation Street (ITV): Lill joined the cast in 2023 as duty solicitor Joel Deering, initially introduced in the Lauren Bolton storyline before becoming romantically involved with Dee-Dee Bailey. The character’s arc developed into one of the soap’s major plots, revealing Joel as a manipulative predator who groomed young women and targeted Lauren. His exit formed part of a whodunnit narrative in which Joel’s death was followed by a live ITVX reaction show; the killer was revealed in a flashback episode as Lauren Bolton, with Lill discussing the twist and its “soap justice.” Subsequent reporting indicated Lill would reprise Joel for a short stint in 2025, though ITV did not issue an official comment at the time. 

### Stage

- The Sociable Plover (Old Red Lion Theatre, London): Lill starred opposite Jack Robertson in Medium Rare Productions’ twentieth-anniversary revival of Tim Whitnall’s dark comedic thriller, directed by Christa Harris. The run played from 13 to 24 May 2025. Independent coverage described the production’s tone and structure, with the cast credited and the work’s tension highlighted. 

- Jack and the Beanstalk (Bournemouth Pavilion Theatre): Lill performed as the villain Fleshcreep in the 2024–2025 season, running from 7 December 2024 to 5 January 2025. In venue publicity, he discussed returning to live theatre after a year of screen work and the significance of pantomime for young audiences. 

- Jack and the Beanstalk (Oak Theatre, Scarisbrick Hall): Lill reprised Fleshcreep at the newly opened Oak Theatre in December 2025, in a production by Anton Benson Productions. Regional and trade coverage confirmed the casting and dates. 

### Public appearances and media

Lill has been active in charity and public events alongside Coronation Street colleagues. BBC News reported that he was among participants at the start of the Greater Manchester half-marathon in 2024, a fundraising event that raised about £1.5 million for national and local charities. 

## Reception

Lill’s portrayal of Joel Deering drew significant attention as the storyline escalated. In interview coverage, he reflected on the narrative’s intensity and his effort to keep the performance grounded, while official Coronation Street content and media recaps framed the plot’s progression toward a whodunnit climax with a live reaction show. On stage, The Sociable Plover’s revival was noted by theatre blogs for its pacing and atmosphere, with Lill credited among the leads. 

## Awards and honours

- Inside Soap Awards 2024: Coronation Street listed “Calum Lill – Joel Deering” among its nominations highlighted for the year’s awards. 

- British Soap Awards (Villain of the Year): Regional press reported Coronation Street’s social media spotlight on Lill’s longlisting for Villain of the Year, with Lill acknowledging the response from viewers. 

## Personal life

Lill announced his engagement to his partner, Roberta, in June 2024, with entertainment press reporting the news and sharing his social media post about the proposal. In late 2025 he posted a holiday-themed announcement that the couple are expecting their first child, adding “New character dropping April ’26”; the pregnancy news was covered by multiple outlets. Lill’s family has occasionally featured in media coverage—for example, a widely viewed video of his grandmother’s reaction to a Coronation Street twist—but detailed private information has not been broadly published by reliable sources. 

## Selected credits

- Doctors (BBC One) — “Division” (Series 20); Chez Wilson-Needham 

- Hollyoaks (Channel 4) — PC Carlton Smith (recurring, 2021) 

- Coronation Street (ITV) — Joel Deering (2023–2024; brief return reported 2025) 

### Theatre

- The Sociable Plover — Old Red Lion Theatre, London (May 2025) 

- Jack and the Beanstalk (Fleshcreep) — Bournemouth Pavilion Theatre (Dec 2024–Jan 2025) 

- Jack and the Beanstalk (Fleshcreep) — Oak Theatre, Scarisbrick Hall (Dec 2025) 

## Training

- Arts Educational Schools London (ArtsEd): BA (Hons) Acting (2018) 

## Notes on identification and notability

Reliable mainstream and trade sources identify Calum Lill as a British actor working in UK television and theatre, with significant roles on Coronation Street and Hollyoaks. His Coronation Street storyline generated extensive reporting across national entertainment outlets and official broadcaster content, establishing notability through sustained coverage. Verified venue and company pages confirm stage credits and dates, and his professional education is supported by established industry profiles.

Viewers of [Coronation Street](https://www.radiotimes.com/tv/soaps/coronation-street/) know exactly how much of a rogue Joel (played by Calum Lill) is, even if the residents of Weatherfield don't yet.

Ad

In the coming weeks, Joel's terrible secrets catch up with him, as Dee-Dee (Channique Sterling-Brown) gets ever closer to the truth.

She will spot an email from him next week on the ITV soap which will ask him to rate his experience of Belfast Airport.

Quick-thinking Joel lies and says he had to go for work but it was cancelled - leaving Dee-Dee less than convinced.

Later on, a charm bracelet comes back to bite him, when Dee-Dee offers Emily a fairy charm for Maeve's bracelet, but Emily is confused as Maeve doesn't have a charm bracelet...

###### More like this

[![Image 5: Calum Lill as Joel and Channique Sterling-Brown as Dee-Dee in Coronation Street. They are smiling as they look across at someone.](https://images.immediate.co.uk/production/volatile/sites/3/2024/07/joel-dee-dee-corrie-c236ff5.jpg?quality=90&resize=93,62)](https://www.radiotimes.com/tv/soaps/coronation-street/coronation-street-calum-lill-joel-dee-dee-exclusive-newsupdate/)

[#### Coronation Street's Joel will do "anything" to marry Dee-Dee, says Calum Lill](https://www.radiotimes.com/tv/soaps/coronation-street/coronation-street-calum-lill-joel-dee-dee-exclusive-newsupdate/)

What's more, she reveals Joel's still paying rent on his old flat, leaving Dee-Dee reeling.

Inquisitive Dee-Dee heads straight to the flat and has a rummage around... what will she find?

Lill has spoken about evil Joel's latest conundrum to press including [RadioTimes.com](http://radiotimes.com/), teasing that Joel will go to any lengths to keep the truth hidden.

![Image 6: Lauren sits in a hospital bed as Joel stands nearby in Coronation Street](https://images.immediate.co.uk/production/volatile/sites/3/2024/07/corrie-lauren-joel-1eaedc0.jpg?quality=90&fit=700,467)

Lauren and Joel in Coronation Street.ITV

**How is Joel feeling since the birth of his and Lauren's son?**

**Calum Lill:** "It’s gone from being a problem he needs to fix to being a human and thinking that this is his child. I think paternal instincts had to kick in but everything’s up in the air, and there’s this weird juxtaposition of something he can’t help but love as a father, but is also a massive problem for him. It’s just another plate he has to spin, another problem to try and navigate.

"There’s so many issues [he is] trying to deal with - if any one of them falls, they all fall. For Joel, with desperate times come desperate measures. The more things stand in the way of him having his happy ever after with Dee-Dee, the worst the experience he’s prepared to go to."

**Does he still think he can marry Dee-Dee and live happily ever after, or is there a sense it's starting to fall apart?**

**CL:** "For any sane person, I think there is; for Joel, I think he absolutely still thinks that’s what he wants and that’s what’s going to happen, and he’ll do whatever it takes to make sure it does."

**Dee-Dee challenges him on a few things, like an unexplained trip to Belfast. How does he explain it?**

**CL:** "The great thing is you’ve got two people who, for their job, they interrogate, they defend, they deflect and are going up against each other. So she cross-examines him, he’s coming up with excuses and deflecting, coming up with plausible things and trying to direct her in other ways. Interesting to watch play out, they are both very good at getting answers a battle of wits and expertise."

**Is he confident he can shut her suspicions down?**

**CL:**"In the moments where he believes he’s bought his explanation, there is a ‘phew’ moment, but I don’t think there’s a moment where he’s proud of himself for pulling the wool over her eyes, because he is genuinely head over heels in love with her and all he wants is to settle down with her. So he’s going to lie like his life depends on it at this point. And it literally does! His life as he knows it…"

**Does he feel guilt for what he's done, the lies, even framing Nathan?**

**CL:**"Absolutely, the guilt is there, but [he] has this warped view, sees himself the same way a soldier in a worthy cause would. It’s hard to do these things but it’s the right thing to do - in his twisted brain he knows it’s tough but it’s the right thing to do, and it’s what he has to do."

**How far is Joel prepared to go to keep his secrets - is the worst yet to come?**

**CL:** "Obviously I can’t say how far, but it's further than I thought he would go. When I read it I was scared to even play it, because it was that dark! He’ll go to any lengths that he needs to."

Sign out of ContentPass

**How do you feel as we get closer to the reveal and for the audience to see it?**

**CL:** "First of all, there seems to be a thing where people question how has Dee-Dee fallen for this, how has she been so stupid, seen what’s right in front of her – but there’s been nothing right in front of her because he’s hidden everything. A lot of victims of abuse and manipulation, it’s not their fault [that] they haven’t seen it. He’s hidden everything and is really manipulative.

"Selfishly, I absolutely love working here, so it bodes well for me the better Joel is at hiding things! In true soap justice he can’t get away with what he’s done, especially 'cos of how bad the things he’s done are.

"So I think it's bittersweet for me as an actor, it's getting more and more juicy, but as soon as this comes to a climax I leave this incredible place filled with so many people I’ve come to know and love, and [who have] been some of my best friends over the last 18 months.

"I’m very excited to get to the end of the story, but it will be very bittersweet because it’s the most incredible place to work."

**What reaction have you had from the public since the reveal of Joel's dark side?**

**CL:** "I get a lot of double takes usually in the supermarket. Because I’m a baddie, less people speak to me because they’re scared I might do something bad – obviously not; I’m an actor!

"The way it goes is there’ll be some woman looking down at some vegetables, she’ll look up, look back down, look back up, realise it’s me, her jaw will drop and then she’ll go over to her husband and tap him furiously and start whispering. And he’ll be clueless as to what she’s talking about! That’s usually the way it goes. It makes me smile!"

**No one has hit you with their handbag?**

**CL:** "I think I’ve been very fortunate. I’ve tried to be quite active on social media to create some sort of separation between me and the character, and the video of my grandma’s reaction to Joel is doing quite well; people seem to have realised I’m not Joel!"

**What's been your most challenging moment on Corrie so far?**

**CL:**"We’ve just done the hour-long episode that was almost entirely me and Cait Fitton, who plays Lauren. I thought it was a really adventurous and brave thing to write, me and Cait both felt privileged to be handed that and trusted with it.

"From filming that, it’s the volume - some of the guys who’ve been here a long time warned me that when it's busy, it's busy! Don’t lock yourself away, chat to us because we know how it is.

"When you’re doing 40 pages a day then you finish and need to learn 40 pages for the next few days, it’s so relentless. To try and bring some sort of quality to that, it’s such a skill, a baptism by fire. That was the most challenging. Everyone says you’ll leave a different actor then when you started, because you can’t not learn and develop so fast from the sheer volume of work."

Coronation Street casts Hollyoaks actor as Dee-Dee Bailey's next love interest
==============================================================================

Calum Lill will play Joel on the ITV soap.

By [George Lewis](https://www.digitalspy.com/author/253498/george-lewis/ "George Lewis")Published: 30 August 2023

![Image 6: Play Icon](https://www.digitalspy.com/_assets/design-tokens/fre/static/icons/play.db7c035.svg?primary=%2523ffffff)![Image 7: channique sterlingbrown as deedee bailey in coronation street](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/coronation-street-channique-sterling-brown-dee-dee-bailey2-6409a48e0a427.jpg?crop=0.605xw:0.511xh;0.189xw,0.129xh)

**_[Coronation Street](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/)_****spoilers follow.**

_[Coronation Street](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a44939129/coronation-street-daniel-brocklebank-romantic-holiday-boyfriend/)_ has cast former _[Hollyoaks](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/hollyoaks/)_ star Calum Lill as Dee-Dee Bailey's next love interest.

Dee-Dee has focused on her career ever since arriving in Weatherfield, but upcoming scenes will see the [lawyer take more of an interest in her dating life](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a44819107/coronation-street-spoilers-dee-dee-romance-story/) following the arrival of Lill's Joel, a solicitor assigned to [the case of Lauren Bolton](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a44916369/coronation-street-spoilers-lauren-bolton-faces-arrest/).

What to Read Next
-----------------

In next week's scenes, Lauren will be arrested for committing criminal damage after a violent outburst, with her rage stemming from her jealousy over Max's relationship with Sabrina.

![Image 8: lauren bolton, coronation street](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/lauren-bolton-roy-coronation-street-64e715aea7828.jpg?crop=0.844xw:1.00xh;0.156xw,0&resize=980:*)

ITV

**Related:**[**_Coronation Street_ spoilers - Stu Carpenter supports Eliza in emotional scenes**](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a44941280/coronation-street-spoilers-stu-supports-eliza/)

Roy is initially terrified after Lauren's arrest, and summons Dee-Dee to help Lauren with her case. Her mind isn't solely on the case, however, with the introduction of duty solicitor Joel making her head spin.

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below

Could romance be in the air for Dee-Dee?

Lill, who has also appeared in _[Doctors](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/doctors/)_ and _[Casualty](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/casualty/)_, had a guest part on _[Hollyoaks](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/hollyoaks/a44913588/hollyoaks-spoilers-charlie-devastating-twist/)_ in 2021, assuming the role of PC Carlton Smith in the Channel 4 soap.

Channique Sterling-Brown, who joined _Corrie_ as Dee-Dee last year, r[ecently spoke about the upcoming developments](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a44819107/coronation-street-spoilers-dee-dee-romance-story/) for her character, revealing that her world is a mixture of "fun and chaos".

![Image 9: dee dee, coronation street](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/dee-dee-coronation-street-1663236366.jpg?crop=0.660xw:0.783xh;0.0933xw,0.140xh&resize=980:*)

ITV

**Related:**[**_Coronation Street_ spoilers - character to reappear after lengthy break**](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a44939954/coronation-street-spoilers-jack-webster-return/)

"I think we're going to see Dee-Dee in a new light. We're going to see her go on a bit of a dating journey," she said. "Her life is a mixture of fun but chaos, and I think fans will really enjoy seeing her try to navigate that world.

"When she's in the courtroom, she's totally in control. I think it's going to be really fun to see her struggle to quite work things out, so that's what we've got coming up. She's probably missed all sorts of romantic opportunities because she's had her head either in the clouds or in the courtroom! I think it's going to be really exciting to see her work all of that out, have a bit of fun and put herself first."

**_Coronation Street_****airs on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays at 8pm on ITV1 and streams on ITVX.**

Meet Calum Lill!
================

[News](https://www.bournemouthpavilion.co.uk/news) 12 November 2024 

![Image 1: Jack and the Beanstalk with Calum Lill](https://d16t72xb5qoggp.cloudfront.net/_imager/files/Shows/Pavilion/667065/PTB-Jack-and-the-Beanstalk-Calum-Reveal-1920x1080px_738b6fcb4cdcd2747dd0b712356884b2.jpg)

News Story
----------

We caught up with Corrie villain, Calum Lill, ahead of his role as the Fleshcreep this Christmas in our 2024 panto _Jack and the Beanstalk_!

**1. Are you excited to be coming to Bournemouth this Christmas?**

Oh yes I am! What a beautiful part of the country to spend the festive season in.

**2. What are you most looking forward to in this year’s panto?**

After doing solely recorded acting on TV for Corrie over the past 12 months, I’m looking forward to being on stage and hearing the audiences’ reaction live and in the moment.

**3. What does doing panto mean to you?**

I think panto is a very special thing. For most children, it’s the first time they ever see a play in a theatre. I was first ever mesmerised by the idea of what acting was when I was about six years old and saw a panto of Peter Pan. I vividly remember looking at the actress who played Peter during the bow with complete admiration and curiosity about what she had just done.

**4. What do you enjoy the most about playing a villain?**

I still don’t understand quite what the draw to playing villains is, but I just know it’s extremely fun… despite the booing.

**5. What is your favourite Christmas tradition?**

Playing silly games with loved ones in the evening whilst dealing with the heartburn from all the pigs in blankets, wine, and Christmas cake!

**_Don't miss Calum this festive season in Jack and the Beanstalk, coming to Bournemouth Pavilion from Saturday 7 December 2024 – Sunday 5 January 2025._**

Nothing and nobody will stop Roy Tunt from spotting his wild birds and today, a stormy December morning on England's desolate east coast, he pursues a very special mission. With one more tick in his dog-eared notebook, Roy will have recorded all 567 species on the British List. The prevailing conditions are ideal and the time is perfect to welcome an elusive vagrant from the Asian Steppe, the rare and beautiful Sociable Plover.

Roy sequesters himself away in a bird-spotter's hide on a stretch of flooded marshland. With a packed lunch and a framed photograph of his ex-wife for company, he watches and waits. But who is the tall, dark and handsome stranger battling his way through the flood waters towards him? All will be revealed inside the hide...

Tim Whitnall's fantastically dark comedic thriller debuted at the Old Red Lion Theatre in 2005, first presented by Feather Productions, starring the author himself opposite Alex Macqueen.

This twentieth anniversary revival is presented by resident company Medium Rare Productions.

![Image 7: The cast of Scarisbrick's Jack and the Beanstalk: (l-r) Calum Lill, Michael Lawless, Suzanne Fulton, Mary Shanker and David Dale, with Danny Childs in front](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/aef8ff_b5a19272f638450fa411d5a523272255~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_740,h_377,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_avif,quality_auto/aef8ff_b5a19272f638450fa411d5a523272255~mv2.jpg)

The cast of Scarisbrick's Jack and the Beanstalk: (l-r) Calum Lill, Michael Lawless, Suzanne Fulton, Mary Shanker and David Dale, with Danny Childs in front

Coronation Street villain Calum Lill - he recently met a sticky end in the soap as tricksy lawyer Joel Deering - becomes pantomime baddie Fleshcreep in _Jack and the Beanstalk_ at the newly-opened Oak Theatre in the grounds of Scarisbrick Hall near Southport (December 13-24).

Panto royalty David Dale plays Dame Trott. A survivor of 25 seasonal shows, David's highlights include pantomimes at the London Palladium and Birmingham Hippodrome; last year he was nominated for a prestigious UK Pantomime Award.

When Jack Trott swaps the family cow for a bag of beans, his mum isn’t best pleased. But when the beans sprout... and keep growing... they lead to the tallest of adventures in the clouds.

The Oak Theatre is a new, state of the art, 390-seat venue in the grounds of the award-winning Scarisbrick Hall School.

General manager Tom Cain said: “Excitement is really building here before we welcome the first audiences to our first pantomime. Seeing our cast in full costume has really got us in the Christmas spirit.”

=======================================================================================

Coronation Street's Calum Lill has shared his response to finding out who killed his character Joel Deering - and it's safe to say he's happy with the outcome

By[Joe Crutchley](https://www.express.co.uk/search?author=Joe%20Crutchley&s=&b=1)

21:15, Fri, Nov 15, 2024

### Coronation Street: DC Swain receives update on Joel

[Coronation Street's](https://www.express.co.uk/latest/coronation-street "Coronation Street") very own Calum Lill, who portrayed the solicitor Joel Deering, has opened up about his exit from the [ITV](https://www.express.co.uk/latest/itv "ITV") show and his feelings about discovering his character's killer.

Rising to stardom in 2023 with his debut on the soap, Lill initially appeared to be the quintessential good guy and even sparked a romance with Dee-Dee Bailey, played by Channique Sterling-Brown. But it didn't take long for Joel's dark past to unravel, shedding light on his history of grooming and abuse towards young girls, particularly Lauren Bolton (Cait Fitton), whom he once tried to murder, leading her to flee.

Article continues below ADVERTISEMENT

The sordid reality of Joel's sins came out, culminating in September with the grim discovery of his body in a river. Although initially thought to be a drowning, post-mortem analysis hinted at foul play, setting off a thrilling "whodunnit" mystery.

Several Weatherfield regulars found themselves embroiled as suspects in the weeks succeeding his death, causing much suspicion amongst them, including Dee-Dee and Carla Connor (Alison King). The anticipation reached its peak during the Friday episode (November 15) when the show finally exposed Joel's perpetrator.

In a striking flashback sequence, viewers watched as Lauren delivered the fatal blow to Joel before dumping his body in the river, only to be later uncovered by police.

Article continues below ADVERTISEMENT

**Don't miss:**[Coronation Street legend shares wedding update saying 'we're astounded'](https://www.express.co.uk/showbiz/tv-radio/1975942/ITV-Coronation-Street-Maureen-Lipman)

![Image 5: Calum Lill](https://cdn.images.express.co.uk/img/dynamic/20/590x/secondary/Calum-Lill-5764270.jpg?r=1731589384433)

Calum Lill has shared his reaction to finding out Joel Deering's killer (Image: ITV)

With the murder revelation being the talk of the Cobbles, Calum Lill has since spoken exclusively to Reach and other media outlets, candidly expressing his thoughts on his dramatic departure and the narrative twist that brought an end to Joel.

Article continues below ADVERTISEMENT

When quizzed about his prior knowledge of the character's fate, Calum revealed: "At first, we were all really confused and trying to work out what was going on because we were getting snippets of this and snippets of that."

"And I eventually found out maybe a couple of months before shooting it that it was going to Lauren. But also that it was going to be so many twists and turns along the way."

![Image 8: Lauren Bolton in Coronation Street](https://cdn.images.express.co.uk/img/dynamic/20/590x/secondary/Lauren-Bolton-in-Coronation-Street-5764266.jpg?r=1731589384442)

Lauren Bolton was revealed as Joel's killer (Image: ITV)

Discussing his reaction to the revelation that Lauren was the killer, Calum wittily remarked that it is "what he [Joel] deserves."

He elaborated: "When I found out it was Lauren I thought soap justice is definitely a thing, and I think that's the best justice he could have got."

"He attacked her viscously and nearly killed her, so for it to be able to come full circle, and for him to get his comeuppance from the person he attacked when she was vulnerable and defenceless I think, is what he deserves."

View 2 Images

Coronation Street star Calum Lill(Image: Calum Lill Instagram)

[Coronation Street](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/all-about/coronation-street)star Calum Lill has excitedly shared his next move with fans, five months after his final scenes as villain Joel Deering aired.

The actor joined the ITV soap as the solicitor in September 2023. But just over a year later, Joel was dramatically killed off as the truth about his smooth and professional exterior was exposed.

who Dee-Dee Bailey soon fell head over heels in love with. But under his smooth exterior Joel was hiding a dark secret - a penchantJoel later became public enemy number one and as Lauren Bolton, Dee-Dee Bailey and DS Lisa Swain all rallied to bring him down after the truth was finally revealed.

However, it was no surprise when Joel disappeared. But when his body was found following an apparent suicide, the police soon discovered that someone had in fact murdered Joel.

It was confirmed he'd been killed with a heavy weapon before entering the water and several Weatherfield residents were put in the frame - Dee-Dee, her father Ed, her uncle Ronnie, Mason [Radcliffe](https://www.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/all-about/radcliffe), Lisa, Carla Connor, DC Kit Green and finally Max Turner and Lauren Bolton.

It was then revealed that in an eventful night for Joel, after Ronnie and Ed went after him with a crowbar, he was attacked by scorned ex Dee-Dee, threatened by Kit and pushed into the river by Max. But not before Lauren had delivered the killer blow amidst their train track confrontation.

After ditching the cobbles for a role in panto at the end of last year, Calum went on to enjoy sunnier climes as he headed travelling around South East Asia

Now back in the UK, Calum had some exciting news to share. "Really exciting, I've got my next acting job. I'm doing a play in London at the Old Red Lion Theatre from the 13th to the 24th of May...."

He'll be appearing in The Sociable Plover, Tim Whitnall's fantastically dark comedic thriller, which previously debuted at the Old Red Lion Theatre in 2005.

Responding to the news, former Corrie co-star Alex Bain said: "Incredible news Calum! I’ll try get to see it if I can do mate!" @cobblesfan commented: "Ooh good luck ur gonna be amazing."

@tracy.c70 replied: "This is absolutely awesome for you Calum, wishing you all the luck." @millzzz_xox posted: "Good luck calum! proud of you." @jill.clark.7121 added: "@calumlill really pleased you are back on Instagram and you have a new job in the theatre. Best of luck you'll smash it."

![Image 3: Calum Lill is nominated for Villain of the Year at the British Soap Awards 2025](https://i2-prod.manchestereveningnews.co.uk/article31481018.ece/ALTERNATES/s1200e/0_JSR_MEN_210425_CalumLill.jpg)

View 2 Images

Calum had some news about his former Corrie role(Image: Calum Lill Instagram)

It comes after Corrie marked Calum's 'return' to the soap world, but only to mark his nod at the upcoming British Soap Awards in which he has been longlisted for villain of the year.

Sharing the news on Instagram, the soap said: "He had us all on the edge of our seats and played a blinder as Joel! If you think Calum Lill deserves Villain Of The Year at this year's Soap Awards then vote now! (Link in bio!) #Corrie #SoapAwards @calumlill @thebritishsoapawards."

Calum later reshared the post to his Instagram Story and said: "What a gift to come back from travelling to this nomincation. Thanks everyone who's voted and if you'd like to, here's the link."

Article continues below

And fans were quick to respond with the same message. @monchhichifanuk said: "When an actor is SO good they convince you they are actually like that in real life, that’s what Callum did! Have voted for him." @xjeankellyx wrote: "He gets my vote. Good luck Callum."

@gigsy27 commented: "He’s one of the best actors on TV he gets our vote for sure I’m certain he will be head hunted for future films & series.. He would be fabulous in I’m a celebrity." ~@laurenb5982 replied: "Calum gets my vote." @caitlinthegoober added: "You know for sure I voted for him."

Coronation Street's Calum Lill pays sweet tribute to real-life partner amid big Joel story
==========================================================================================

"I'm so grateful to have you in my life."

By [Sara Baalla](https://www.digitalspy.com/author/273958/sara-baalla/ "Sara Baalla")Published: 29 September 2024

![Image 8: Play Icon](https://www.digitalspy.com/_assets/design-tokens/fre/static/icons/play.db7c035.svg?primary=%2523ffffff)![Image 9: joel in coronation street](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/calum-lill-joel-coronation-street-1-66c636a7430e3.jpg?crop=1xw:0.9718045112781954xh;0,0)

_**[Coronation Street](http://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/)**_**spoilers follow.**

_Coronation Street_ star [Calum Lill](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a62040957/coronation-street-calum-lill-co-star-tribute/) has paid tribute to his real-life partner amid his character [Joel Deering's big storyline](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a62229058/coronation-street-spoilers-joel-deering-new-mysteries/).

The actor took to [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DAbdSLoCYAZ/?img_index=9) on Saturday (September 28) to post some of his "favourite" pictures of himself and fiancée Roberta Mcclarron, which included one of the pair posing outside the Rovers Return. The couple [got engaged](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a61129996/coronation-street-calum-lill-engaged-roberta-mcclarron/) back in June.

What to Read Next
-----------------

"Ah my partner in crime. For the last year I've been totally focused on my career which has meant you have come second and I've hardly seen you," the post's caption read.

![Image 10: instagram](https://www.digitalspy.com/_assets/design-tokens/fre/static/icons/social/instagram.f282b14.svg?primary=currentColor&id=link-out-embed)[View full post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DAbdSLoCYAZ/)

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below

**Related: [Best film and TV tours for 2024](https://www.digitalspy.com/tv/a46265799/best-film-tv-tours-2024/)**

"Some people might have gotten upset or pissed off at this, but you have done nothing but support me in chasing my dream. On top of your own job, you've looked after our home.

"You've done pretty much all of the cooking and cleaning, all my washing, the pots, the decorating, and you've taken it in your stride and never grumbled even on the many days when I was gone before you woke up and got into bed after you were asleep."

Lill concluded: "You did this because you knew it's what I needed and you supported me completely. I'm so grateful to have you in my life and that you agreed to marry me. Thanks for being amazing."

![Image 11: joel in coronation street](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/calum-lill-joel-coronation-street-1-66c636a7430e3.jpg?crop=0.868xw:1.00xh;0.0215xw,0&resize=980:*)

ITV

**Related: [_Coronation Street_, _EastEnders_, _Emmerdale_ and _Home and Away_ death plots to come](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a62406092/coronation-street-eastenders-emmerdale-death-plots/)**

_Coronation Street_ is set to air an unexpected ending in Joel Deering's storyline next week. DS Swain will announce [the villain's death](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a62333124/coronation-street-spoilers-joel-deering-story-death/) after unearthing some troubling evidence, although Joel's ex-fiancée [Dee-Dee Bailey](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a62035631/coronation-street-joel-dee-dee-revenge/) worries that everything is not as it seems.

On Friday (September 27), Joel failed to show up to his plea hearing, with the judge subsequently issuing a warrant for his arrest.

Meanwhile, a visibly drunk Joel locked himself into Roy's Rolls, where he [expressed his "guilt"](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a62412977/coronation-street-twist-death-joel/) to café owner Roy Cropper – who was [wrongly imprisoned](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a60437790/coronation-street-spoilers-roy-cropper-prison-story/) for killing [Lauren Bolton](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a61776732/coronation-street-spoilers-joel-plot-lauren-pregnancy/). It soon became clear that Joel was pretending to be drunk.

Later, he recorded a message for Dee-Dee, telling her that he still loves her, before the camera revealed a large wound on his face. What is Joel planning?

**_Coronation Street_ airs on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays at 8pm on ITV1 and streams on [ITVX](https://www.itv.com/).**

UK Regional Theatre Newsletter Get all the top news & discounts for UK Regional & beyond. ✨ Sign Up Coronation Street star Calum Lill is set to embark on a giant adventure this Christmas as he headlines a pantomime at a new Scarisbrick venue. Jack and the Beanstalk comes to the Oak Theatre at Scarisbrick Hall near Ormskirk from Saturday 13 – Wednesday 24 December. Tickets are on sale now priced from £14. ### LATEST NEWS [Bobbie Little Joins COVEN at the Kiln Theatre](https://www.broadwayworld.com/article/Bobbie-Little-Joins-COVEN-at-the-Kiln-Theatre-20251222) [Kings Head Theatre Adds Extra Adults-Only Performances of JACK AND THE BEANSTALK](https://www.broadwayworld.com/article/Kings-Head-Theatre-Adds-Extra-Adults-Only-Performances-of-JACK-AND-THE-BEANSTALK-20251222) [BALLET NIGHTS DECADANCE Celebrates 10th Show in London](https://www.broadwayworld.com/article/BALLET-NIGHTS-DECADANCE-Celebrates-10th-Show-in-London-20251222) [Photos: Kym Marsh, Lisa Faulkner and More in Rehearsal For SINGLE WHITE FEMALE UK Tour](https://www.broadwayworld.com/article/Photos-Kym-Marsh-Lisa-Faulkner-and-More-in-Rehearesal-For-SINDLE-WHITE-FEMALE-UK-Tour-20251222) ### 🎭 NEW! UK Regional Theatre Newsletter Get all the top news & discounts for UK Regional & beyond. ✨ Sign Up Calum, who trod the Weatherfield cobbles as the Street's bad boy Joel Deering, Calum will play the evil Fleshcreep in the lavish panto which is presented by Anton Benson Productions Ltd. And he will be joined on the Oak Theatre stage by legendary pantomime dame [David Dale](https://www.broadwayworld.com/people/David-Dale/) who appears as Dame Trott. The cast is completed by real-life couple Danny Childs and Sue Fulton as Jack Trott and Princess Jill, Mary Shanker as Mary the Fairy and Michael Lawless as King Bling. When Jack Trott swaps the family cow for a bag of beans, his mum isn't best pleased. But when the beans sprout…and keep growing, they lead to the tallest of adventures in the clouds. Can Jack outwit the wily Fleshcreep and rescue his sweetheart Princess Jill from the clutches of the giant? Or will he fee-fi-fo fumble his chance to be a hero? There's only one way to find out. Audiences can expect two-and-a-half hours of toe-tapping song and dance, colourful costumes, fantastic sets – encompassing the venue's 4k digital wall, and stunning special effects all wrapped up in a hilarious laugh-a-minute script. Calum Lill is best known for playing Coronation Street villain Joel Deering who met a sticky end at the heart of a dramatic whodunit which kept soap viewers on the edge of their seats. His other screen credits include PC Carlton Smith in Hollyoaks and roles in Doctors and Holby City. His stage credits include The Sociable Plover at London's Old Red Lion. And he returns to the role of Fleshcreep after playing him last Christmas in Bournemouth. Meanwhile when he is not causing drama on screen, he loves bringing stories to life on stage and helping other actors through his coaching company Screen Ready. Calum said today: “I loved my time playing Fleshcreep last Christmas, so I'm excited to return to the role this season and also to be able to perform in such a fantastic new space like the Oak Theatre. I can guarantee audiences plenty of laughs, magic and festive cheer. “Pantomime is often the first time a child is introduced to the thrill of live theatre, and I remember myself as a small boy being absolutely mesmerised by Peter Pan. I'm looking forward to getting back on stage as the baddie – bring on the booing!” The Oak Theatre is a stunning new state-of-the-art 390-seat venue situated in the sweeping grounds of the award-winning Scarisbrick Hall School. It champions bold storytelling and boundary-pushing performances, bringing together visionary creatives and engaged audiences to shape the future of live entertainment. The theatre has partnered with veteran panto producer Anton Benson Productions to present its first professional pantomime on the stage. ABP produces successful Christmas pantomimes for five other venues across the North West in addition to providing Easter pantos for more than 15 venues across the UK each spring. The company has worked with many big-name stars including [Les Dennis](https://www.broadwayworld.com/people/Les-Dennis/), John Thomson, Kerry Katona, Mark Labbett, [Su Pollard](https://www.broadwayworld.com/people/Su-Pollard/) and Basil Brush. Producer Anton Benson said today: “We're delighted to add the Oak Theatre to our Christmas panto family, and that we have a Coronation Street icon to launch our first year. “It's always exciting to help a new venue build a pantomime audience and we're looking forward to bringing our brand of laughter and pantomime magic to Scarisbrick.” Oak Theatre general manager Tom Cain said: “I'm thrilled to announce Oak Theatre's first ever pantomime, Jack and the Beanstalk, which will fill the auditorium with laughter this Christmas. Anton Benson is a hugely respected and experienced panto production company which delivers top quality entertainment, so I know our audiences are in for a real festive treat. “Along with the public performances there will be six schools-only shows during the run, plus an adults-only night, so I can guarantee a good time for all, whether you're four or 94.” Schools' performances will take place during the day from 15 – 19 December. Calum Lill was so close to quitting acting when he landed a part in [Coronation Street](https://www.mirror.co.uk/all-about/coronation-street) that he “fell to his knees, sobbing” with relief when the offer came through.

The actor, who plays Joel Deering, the new boyfriend of Channique Sterling-Brown’s solicitor Dee-Dee Bailey, said he was put through a rigorous audition process for the soap. It went on for weeks and at the time Calum was hating his job as a car salesman.

“And then my phone started vibrating in my pocket, and it was my agent. I walked on to the forecourt. And he went, ‘You got it’. And, like the absolute drama queen that I am, I just fell to my knees. I was sobbing. I couldn’t speak.

“I was getting to the age where we wanted to save up for a house. And I just thought, ‘98% of actors don’t act full-time. Unfortunately, I think I’m in that 98%’.”

Calum, 28, who played PC Carlton Smith in Hollyoaks, said his first day on the set in Salford blew his mind. “I felt like Julia Roberts in Pretty Woman. I was just walking past people I’ve known in my living room since I was five... and I was like, ‘This is insane’.”

Article continues below

Calum previously revealed that he was nearly “homeless” during the COVID-19 lockdown due to the shutdown of the television industry. He told the ‘Me, Myself and Hopefully You…?’ podcast in 2021: "Most actors, despite being professional actors, you still have to have a job to do, between jobs.

"Unless you're in the top one per cent. It's a hustle. That's what a lot of theatre actors struggle with. They love theatre, but it only pays enough to cover your rent while in you're in the job...You've then got to go back to waiting tables."

Thousands take to streets for city half-marathon
================================================

![Image 1: Hundreds of runners set off en masse at the starting point in the fog. Trees line the road to the side.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/1200/cpsprodpb/cd31/live/e49e9a50-a77f-11f0-9f5f-19b03c1693c8.jpg)Image source, A.S.O. UK

Image caption,

Organisers say about £1.5m have been raised for charities

*   Published
    
    12 October 2025
    

**About 26,000 people have pounded the streets of Greater Manchester for the annual half-marathon.**

They ran 13.1 miles (21km) through the fog on a route that started near Manchester United's stadium, passed near the city centre, and culminated at Lancashire cricket ground.

Organisers said the event raised about £1.5m for national and local charities.

Ninety-year-old Gordon Aaron, who completed his first half-marathon in 2019, and Gladiators contestant Aneila Afsar were among runners taking part in the event, which held its first race in 2016.

![Image 2: Aneila Afsar, who is wearing a dark outfit and red hijab scarf, runs while pushing a buggy with her child. She is surrounded by scores of other participants as they run down a wide road.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/1200/cpsprodpb/9dc0/live/38141210-a77f-11f0-9f5f-19b03c1693c8.jpg)Image source, A.S.O. UK

Image caption,

Gladiators 2025 runner-up Aneila Afsar pushed her daughter in a buggy, having said "my children will be my motivation not my limitation"

![Image 3: Group shot of four male friends smiling as they wear a green caterpillar costume and give thumbs up. They are at the finishing line with other runners coming behind them.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/1152/cpsprodpb/7b76/live/56d28dd0-a77f-11f0-9f5f-19b03c1693c8.jpg)Image source, A.S.O. UK

Image caption,

These friends ran in a caterpillar costume and formation along the 13-mile route

![Image 4: Thousands of runners mass at the start line raising their arms and smiling with an arch above them int he background that has a sign saying "Welcome and good luck". There is fog above.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/1200/cpsprodpb/a149/live/11d2b740-a780-11f0-9f5f-19b03c1693c8.jpg)Image source, A.S.O. UK

Image caption,

The fog didn't dampen spirits at the Sunday morning start

![Image 5: A line of hundreds of spectators watching from behind the metal railings on the route.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/1200/cpsprodpb/64fd/live/01e4cdf0-a780-11f0-9f5f-19b03c1693c8.jpg)Image source, A.S.O. UK

Image caption,

Hundreds of spectators cheered on family and friends taking part

![Image 6: Group picture of Calum Lill in a blue top, and Harriet Bibby and Channique Sterling-Brown who are wearing black tops near the starting point. They are all grinning and giving thumbs-up signs. Other runners are behind them as they wait to start.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/671/cpsprodpb/e1de/live/c8b3b0f0-a77f-11f0-9f5f-19b03c1693c8.jpg)Image source, A.S.O. UK

Image caption,

Coronation Street actors Calum Lill, Harriet Bibby and Channique Sterling-Brown were in high spirits at the start

![Image 7: Gordon Aaron smiles and holds up his medal as he poses for a picture in Old Trafford cricket ground. He wears a blue cap and a blue top with Alzheimer's Society branded on it.](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/ace/standard/480/cpsprodpb/9978/live/ad5a0080-a77e-11f0-9f5f-19b03c1693c8.jpg)Image source, A.S.O. UK

Image caption,

Oldest participant Gordon Aaron, who turned 90 in August, has now completed five Manchester half-marathons

17:48, 07 Dec 2025

Coronation Street actor Calum Lill is preparing to welcome his first child after announcing his fiancée is expecting.

‌  

The 30-year-old actor, who played Joel Deering on [the ITV soap](https://www.ok.co.uk/latest/coronation-street), turned to Instagram to share the delightful news.

‌  

He uploaded a Christmas-themed photograph showing bride-to-be Roberta's bump decorated like a snowman, whilst she displayed a scan image, and the actor positioned a carrot against her tummy.

‌  

"New character dropping April '26," Calum captioned alongside the reveal. The pair have been an item since 2021 and [became engaged last year.](https://www.ok.co.uk/celebrity-news/corries-joel-deering-star-calum-34099640)

"About time I made an honest woman of her," Calum quipped at the time. The performer concealed the engagement ring in his Corrie dressing room whilst awaiting the ideal opportunity, reports [the Mirror](https://www.mirror.co.uk/3am/celebrity-news/breaking-coronation-street-star-become-36364469).

![Image 2: corrie](https://i2-prod.ok.co.uk/article36365684.ece/ALTERNATES/s1200e/0_insta__4_jpg_JS1044015535.jpg)

View 3 Images

The Corrie star is expecting his first child

‌  

Calum Lill portrayed [Coronation Street](https://www.ok.co.uk/latest/coronation-street) baddie Joel Deering, featuring in the programme's most significant mystery storyline for years.

His character, solicitor Deering, was recently exposed as having attacked missing Lauren Bolton with a chair leg.

Nobody was more unimpressed with the plot than Calum's own nan. Calum was seated beside her on the settee when she initially viewed the episode - and his footage of her priceless response has since become a social media sensation.

‌  

![Image 3: corrie](https://i2-prod.ok.co.uk/article36365690.ece/ALTERNATES/s1200e/1_JS371036102.jpg)

View 3 Images

Calum Lill is set to become a first-time dad following Corrie exit

"You mean to tell me my grandson's a killer? You battered her," she fumed. "I can't believe that. Honest to goodness!"

The TikTok footage has now accumulated over eight million views. After the unexpected success, Calum credits his grandmother's sacrifices for launching his career.

‌  

Soap enthusiast Sue used her hard-earned money to fund her grandson's drama lessons from the age of 14 and even chauffeured him back and forth to his classes.

"My grandma is so funny, and I knew she wouldn't be able to believe it. She's a working-class woman from Manchester; she's so proud of me, but I knew her reaction would be priceless.

"We'd \[always\] watch Coronation Street together with a cup of tea, and she used to drive me to my acting classes - from the age of 14.

‌  

![Image 4: corrie](https://i2-prod.ok.co.uk/article36365689.ece/ALTERNATES/s1200e/0_JS345485089.jpg)

View 3 Images

Callum Lil as Joel in Corrie

"So to be able to watch this with her and share that moment was really nice and so special."

Calum's triumph wasn't handed to him on a plate. His mum originally funded the drama tuition but struggled financially to continue.

Article continues below

That's when his nan and granddad stepped in, determined to secure the necessary funds however they could.

"We weren't a family with money," Calum remembers. "And the classes weren't cheap, so I'm glad that I can now make all that expense worth it for her."

20.title: Hiding In Plain Sight - Calum Lill reveals what it's like playing evil Joel.
20.description: Calum Lill reveals what it's like playing evil Joel and what it's been like hiding this huge secret for so long.
20.content:
Friday 31 May at 10:32am![Image 1: JOEL - CORONATION STREET - ITV](https://images.ctfassets.net/ti0n6mm28of1/4Nrt7DhvNj5zFOBvG83Urd/1b7406556d417283edf7886c39dcfe80/joel_land.jpg?fm=jpg&fit=fill&w=708&h=398&q=80)
**How does it feel for you that the public finally knows what you've known for such a long time?**

I'm terrified but it's also a relief. I've known this for over a year. It was last May that I got sent the breakdown for Joel saying that he was a charming character who's got a dark side. When I got the screen test they said, ‘Okay, this is what Joel is going to be doing’. I thought, ‘Oh my goodness, like this is a really terrible person. And I've got to hide in plain sight for a year.’

**So you knew at that point how long it was going to be?**

Yes I did. In my first meeting with the producer he said that they had already storyboarded it month by month, obviously parts of it can change but the arc of the story spanned the year and a lot of detail had been decided which is rare.

**How did you feel?**

I felt a huge weight of responsibility on my shoulders to do well and not give it away and not play some cliche, because the things Joel has done have happened to people in real life. So I had meetings with charities and did research. I watched documentaries and read psychological papers to create as much truth as possible. The thing that I kept in my mind was I would never want anyone who'd experienced anything like that to be watching something on screen that didn’t feel authentic and feel offended.

I did also feel safe because of all the work behind the scenes that went into creating this character and this storyline. Everyone has been so invested in making it quality and making it something to be proud of.

**Was it important to you to make this character likeable, affable and charming so that we didn't start to suspect that there was more to him?**

Yes 100% and a line that I had to tread was I can't make him so nice that it's just ridiculous that he could do this. So I've just been watching documentaries and reading reports on people like this. And one thing that kept coming back to me was that they never suspected them, they were so charming, even right to the extremes of people like Ted Bundy. I've watched hours of footage of Ted Bundy to understand his mannerisms and his intonation, not that Joel is based on him, but just to understand the real person. He's so nice. He's confident and he's charming but that is just a facade.

**Was it helpful for you to have almost the red herring of the ex wife and the divorce and the daughter that you've kept secret from Dee-Dee to give him some sort of side to him that maybe he wasn't as nice as he seemed?**

I think as many people as it's thrown off the scent I think it’s made other viewers believe that they can’t trust him as he's already hurt our beloved Dee-Dee. It was really useful in having a back story and background for him so I can understand how he thinks and how he ticks and his moral compass on that whole situation.

**What was it like keeping that secret and what were people's reactions to you out and about. Did they have suspicions about Joel?**

It has been difficult - even my family don’t know, they will have found out at the same time as the viewers. I don’t think they were suspicious as they probably didn't think I could play an evil character like Joel. I was having Sunday dinner with my family a couple of weeks ago, and they were all talking about their own theories of who they think it is. And every one of them has got a different one and not one of them thinks it is Joel. They have not been suspicious of me at all. They were aware that some people were suspicious online but believed me!

**How is your Gran going to react, you posted on your social media that she was texting you, telling you to be nice to Dee-Dee and upset that Joel was married?**

Haha I don’t know but I am going to try and watch it with her, it will be like watching a horror film, she will lose her mind, she might call the police, she will want to ring Dee-Dee. She has known my girlfriend for four years but she is very invested in Joel and Dee-Dee.

![Image 2: JOEL - CORONATION STREET - ITV](https://images.ctfassets.net/ti0n6mm28of1/5FSRr1mKXwrElObUvDZBvp/7faba070e9c7b9a6d380b6de90c19749/Joel_1.jpeg?fm=jpg&fit=fill&w=708&h=998&q=80)
**We are now in the situation where the audience knows but no one in Weatherfield does. What is next for Joel, is he worried?**

I think he's trying to work out how many loose ends there could be and how to deal with them. Obviously as a defence solicitor he knows how to play the game and knows that there is reasonable doubt and that he needs to cancel out anything that could be tied down to him. But you know, this is new territory for him. He might have been in a situation before where he's broken the law and not treated people very nicely. But this is new and I think he feels real concern. He has to make it stick on Nathan so no one ever suspects it could be Joel.

**How does he feel about representing Nathan?**

It was a huge stroke of luck. He was the duty solicitor on the day that Nathan's questioned. He just happens to be in the right place at the right time, and he is sitting there representing a man who is being wrongly accused of the thing that he did. He is as shocked as Nathan when the hair in Nathan’s car is proved to be Lauren’s. He doesn’t care about Nathan. This could be the thing that gets Roy out of prison and stops Dee-Dee being so stressed about Roy, because he does feel bad about that as he does adore her, that is the one thing that he struggles with and now it looks like the problem is solved.

**Does he feel at all guilty about another innocent man taking the blame for what he has done?**

It doesn't affect him. I think he can justify everything he's ever done in his own head. He's never done anything wrong in his mind. He can justify all of it. Nathan's a groomer and a rapist and he's the scum of the earth. But as far as Joel is concerned, he sees himself as someone who helped a girl and then had a sexual relationship and then she pushed his buttons and she got what she had coming in. And his moral compass is absolutely off, he can compartmentalise anything, because Nathan's done loads wrong it is fine for him to take the rap for this.

**What makes Joel the way he is?**

He is very messed up, he sees women in two ways. He has these women he adores and puts on a pedestal like Dee-Dee and then there are the other women, the young girls that he sees as lesser in some way in his eyes and takes his hatred for women out on them. When he sees these vulnerable young women probably from broken homes, with criminal records and no one looking out for them he is like a shark he hones in on them, coercively controls them and emotionally manipulates them using his power and money. If you were to sit down and try and ask him why he did it he would justify it as just helping them. When no one else would. It is a repetitive pattern of behaviour, he engages with these young girls and afterwards there is the element of guilt so he tries to be a good person and be better towards Dee-Dee. Then the guilt wears off and he needs another ‘fix’, he has a euphoria/guilt cycle. It is a pattern of destructive behaviour. And we will see in the coming weeks that he is still doing it.

**Next week we see him propose to Dee-Dee, is that part of this pattern?**

I think the proposal comes from the fact that he thinks there's a genuine possibility that the game is up.. He's going through a really tough time and he might get in trouble for something that he really believes wasn't his fault. Everything you see about how he acts towards Dee-Dee is genuine. And he's rushing to marry this woman that he genuinely loves. The proposal is partly guilt and it's partly that he thinks he has a good chance that he could go to prison and not see her again. So he's trying to let her know how much he in his own head loves her.

**How long do you think he can continue hiding in plain sight? Is he going to make any mistakes?**

I mean, the longer he hides the more chance there is of him making a mistake. He’s been good so far in that he's been engaging in this behaviour as long as we have seen him, and Lauren was attacked in February. And no one's seen him. No one's caught him out until now but they don’t actually know they have caught him out. But I think the longer it goes on for, the more chance he’s got of slipping up and I think he knows that. You can see that in him getting more and more anxious that the slightest thing could bring his world crumbling down around him, you know, even just the fact that he slept with Lauren. That's a breach of trust alone and will be enough to end his career and relationship plus murder on top of that, his life would be over you know. Everything that he values in his life, his job, his fiance, his freedom? So the stakes couldn't be higher. But when he panics, the more chance there is of something going wrong,

**He's a really, really complex character, with so many facets, do you look forward to getting the scripts to see what he's going to do next? How much are you enjoying playing Joel**?

I absolutely look forward to getting the scripts but I can't even wait for the script. I have to ask the producer if they can sit me down and tell me everything that's going on. I have got a book that I have written month by month from last July of everything up to now that has happened with Joel. I just want to try to understand what on earth is going on inside his head. Just the audacity of the man just carrying on with Dee-Dee, sometimes I read a script and I can't believe what he is doing.

It is such a gift of a part. I couldn't have wished for a better opportunity to be given to me by ITV and Coronation Street. I've never been so busy and I've never had to learn so many lines in my life, but I've also never been so happy and fulfilled.

**You must be hoping then it'll be a little while before it gets caught. Giving you more time to enjoy your job with him hiding in plain sight?**

I hope Joe's very good at hiding because I really enjoy coming to work, but for soap justice I know that at some point he's going to be found out.

If you missed the drama, you can stream now on [ITVX](https://www.itv.com/watch/coronation-street/1a0694)

Coronation Street casts love interest for Dee-Dee Bailey
========================================================

Calum Lill will play new character Joel Deering, who is a duty solicitor.

It looks as though things are about to heat up for Dee-Dee Bailey on [Coronation Street](https://www.radiotimes.com/tv/soaps/coronation-street/), as she is set to meet a new love interest in next week's episodes.

Ad

[The Sun](https://www.thesun.co.uk/tv/23695709/coronation-street-sign-up-hollyoaks-villain-callum-lill/) has reported that Calum Lill, who is best known for his role as PC Carlton Smith in [Hollyoaks](https://www.radiotimes.com/tv/soaps/hollyoaks/), will be joining the Corrie cast as duty solicitor Joel Deering.

The publication states that Joel will first arrive in Weatherfield to help Lauren Bolton, but will then be seen getting close to Dee-Dee.

He is expected to be seen on screen from next week as part of the new storyline.

![Image 7: Calum Lill as PC Carlton Smith in Hollyoaks](https://images.immediate.co.uk/production/volatile/sites/3/2023/08/hollyoaks-calum-lill-86d5bcb.jpg?quality=90&fit=700,467)

Calum Lill as PC Carlton Smith in Hollyoaks.Lime Pictures

As well as appearing in multiple episodes of Hollyoaks, Lill has also been seen in Holby City and [Doctors](https://www.radiotimes.com/tv/soaps/doctors-return-date-revealed-newsupdate/), as well as the short films I Can See Clearly Now, Sleep Warm and Heads or Tails.

Coronation Street villain to return despite dramatic death plot
===============================================================

Guess who's back...

By [George Lewis](https://www.digitalspy.com/author/253498/george-lewis/ "George Lewis")Updated: 29 April 2025

![Image 9: Play Icon](https://www.digitalspy.com/_assets/design-tokens/fre/static/icons/play.db7c035.svg?primary=%2523ffffff)![Image 10: coronation street silhouettes](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/coronation-street-silhouettes-6790c4e03731d.jpg?crop=1.00xw:0.752xh;0,0.0361xh)

**_[Coronation Street](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/)_****spoilers follow.**

_[Coronation Street](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a64607595/coronation-street-spoilers-julie-carp-final-scenes/)_ star [Calum Lill](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a46840582/coronation-street-calum-lill-acting/) will return to the soap less than a year after his character, Joel Deering, was killed off.

The villain met a grisly end back in September as his scheming and malevolence finally caught up with him, with a months-long whodunit eventually revealing that Lauren Bolton – with the help of Max Turner – [was responsible for his murder](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a62921299/coronation-street-joel-killer-reveal-flashback-episode/).

What to Read Next
-----------------

Despite the dramatic death plot, [_The Sun_](https://www.thesun.co.uk/tv/34707102/coronation-street-supervillain-shock-return/) has reported that [Lill](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a62426677/coronation-street-calum-lill-fiancee-tribute/) is due to reprise his role as the villain in a brief stint, though the exact nature of the character's surprise return is yet to be disclosed. Could more flashbacks be on the cards?

_Coronation Street_ is yet to release an official comment.

![Image 11: joel deering, coronation street](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/joel-deering-coronation-street-666a92dabf1a2.jpg?crop=0.8437764606265876xw:1xh;center,top&resize=980:*)

ITV

**Related: [_Coronation Street_ exclusive – Christina's next return confirmed after Daisy's exit](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a64606750/coronation-street-spoilers-christina-return-daisy-exit/)**

Advertisement - Continue Reading Below

Lill, who first played Joel in September 2023, [previously shared that he felt "bittersweet"](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a61834940/coronation-street-calum-lill-emotional-over-leaving/) to be departing the soap, explaining: "I think it's bittersweet for me. As an actor, it's getting more and more juicy.

"But as soon as this comes to a climax, I leave this incredible place filled with so many people I’ve come to know and love - [they've] been some of my best friends over the last 18 months. I’m very excited to get to the end of the story, but it will be very bittersweet because it’s the most incredible place to work."

Since his departure from _Corrie_, [Lill has spent some time on the stage](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a61615164/coronation-street-calum-lill-joel-deering-rumours/) as he portrayed Fleshcreep in Bournemouth Pavilion's production of _Jack & the Beanstalk_, with the show running from December 2024 to January 2025.

![Image 12: max turner, joel deering and lauren bolton in coronation street](https://hips.hearstapps.com/hmg-prod/images/coronation-street-max-tuener-joel-deering-lauren-bolton3-6737b64e2398c.jpg?resize=980:*)

Danielle Baguley//ITV

**Related: [Best streaming services UK 2025 — including Disney Plus, Netflix, iPlayer and Apple TV+](https://www.digitalspy.com/tech/best-tech-deals/g35899960/best-streaming-services/)**

While Joel is set to make a return in some capacity, [Lauren](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a64566817/coronation-street-lauren-reece-bombshell/) is in the thick of the drama in Weatherfield following her recent joyride with Betsy Swain, which saw her crash Tracy McDonald's van after losing control.

Despite being behind the wheel without a license, Lauren initially found herself in the clear after Betsy took the blame when interrogated by the police. Despite her reprieve, Lauren wasn't totally unscathed as a [mystery individual knew that she was behind the wheel](https://www.digitalspy.com/soaps/coronation-street/a64590781/coronation-street-lauren-bolton-targeted-mystery-blackmailer/) - who could it be?...

**_Coronation Street_****airs on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays at 8pm on ITV1 and streams on**[**ITVX**](https://www.itv.com/)**.**

**[Michael Adams](https://metro.co.uk/author/michael-adams/)**

**Published** February 14, 2024 7:00am 

[](whatsapp://send?text=%E2%80%98Sobbing%20and%20crying%27%20Coronation%20Street%20star%20almost%20quit%20acting%20for%20good%20https%3A%2F%2Fmetro.co.uk%2F2024%2F02%2F14%2Fsobbing-crying-coronation-street-star-almost-quit-acting-good-20271866%2F%3Fito%3Darticle.desktop.share.top.whatsapp)[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmetro.co.uk%2F2024%2F02%2F14%2Fsobbing-crying-coronation-street-star-almost-quit-acting-good-20271866%2F%3Fito%3Darticle.desktop.share.top.twitter&text=%26lsquo%3BSobbing%20and%20crying%26%23039%3B%20Coronation%20Street%20star%20almost%20quit%20acting%20for%20good&via=MetroUK)[](https://metro.co.uk/2024/02/14/sobbing-crying-coronation-street-star-almost-quit-acting-good-20271866/)Link is copied[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fmetro.co.uk%2F2024%2F02%2F14%2Fsobbing-crying-coronation-street-star-almost-quit-acting-good-20271866%2F%3Fito%3Darticle.desktop.share.top.facebook)[Comments](https://metro.co.uk/2024/02/14/sobbing-crying-coronation-street-star-almost-quit-acting-good-20271866/#metro-comments-container)

![Image 11: Dee-Dee and Joel facing each other in the middle of an argument in Corrie](https://metro.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/23_02_coro_joel_dee_dee_03-2627.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&w=646)

Joel has been hiding another woman in Coronation Street (Picture: ITV)

Coronation Street star Calum Lill has revealed the struggle to [secure his dream role](https://metro.co.uk/2023/08/31/coronation-street-dee-dee-hollyoaks-calum-lill-19423209/) that saw him almost give up acting.

Joining the [ITV](https://metro.co.uk/tag/itv/) soap last September as Dee-Dee Bailey’s (Channique Sterling-Brown) boyfriend Joel Deering, [viewers were shocked to learn last week that he has been hiding another woman](https://www.google.com/search?client=safari&rls=en&q=joel+corrie+metro&ie=UTF-8&oe=UTF-8).

But before landing the role on the cobbles, Lill had a string of other jobs including at a car dealership and Junkyard Golf Club.

His big break came shortly after he graduated, with Calum telling us: ‘I had one episode on Doctors – it was two days filming and you’d think I’d just been cast as the lead in the new Scorsese epic!’

‘Then I did an episode on Holby City which was fantastic and then lockdown hit’ he explained.

![Image 12: Calum Lill as PC Carlton Smith in Hollyoaks](https://metro.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/hollyoaks-calum-lill-86d5bcb-722c.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&w=646)

The actor has also worked on Hollyoaks (Picture: Lime)

![Image 13: Ed meets Joel as Dee-Dee introduces them at the bistro in Coronation Street](https://metro.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/17_10_coro_joel_dee_dee_ed_01-3b2c.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&w=646)

Joel has made himself at home on the cobbles (Picture: ITV)

‘That threw a spanner in the works.’

Soap fans will remember that Calum also [appeared in twelve episodes of Hollyoaks in 2021](https://metro.co.uk/2021/06/16/hollyoaks-spoilers-sally-exits-as-she-goes-to-prison-after-confessing-her-crime-to-pc-smith-14778466/), and following that he worked on a paella stand at festivals – with a surprising Corrie connection.

‘The owner of it, his brother is Rupert [Hill] and his partner Jenny [Platt], they used to be in Coronation Street’ he said, speaking of the actors who portrayed Jamie Baldwin and Violet Wilson in the show.

![Image 14: Dee-Dee and Joel in Coronation Street](https://metro.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/23_02_coro_joel_dee_dee_02-1553.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&w=646)

Will Joel come clean to Dee-Dee? (Picture: ITV)

‘I’d had an unsuccessful audition at Corrie before and they said: ‘If they like you, they will get you back in, do not worry,’

‘I was a bit down because if you’re working class and northern, all you want to do is something on Coronation Street.’

But now Lill is rubbing shoulders with Corrie’s finest, [including Jenny Platt who is returning as Violet after thirteen years this month](https://metro.co.uk/2024/02/12/coronation-street-confirms-return-major-character-13-years-20260334/).

Explaining the moment his agent told him he bagged the job, Calum enthused: ‘There was a silence that lasted for about ten minutes and then I heard ‘You got it’.’

‘Like the absolute drama queen that I am, I just fell to my knees and was crying and sobbing, I couldn’t speak – I was over the moon.’

[Coronation Street](https://metro.co.uk/tv-soaps/coronation-street/)15 hours ago By [**Jon Boam**](https://metro.co.uk/author/jon-boam/)

3.   [Coronation Street star admits Christmas will 'feel empty' after triple family loss](https://metro.co.uk/2025/12/21/coronation-street-star-admits-christmas-will-feel-empty-triple-family-loss-25612647/)

‘It was a relief that 14 or 15 years had paid off and I wouldn’t have to quit’ he added.

‘There’s no shame in quitting. So many people have to. It’s one of the hardest industries to get into – but to know I didn’t have to was incredible.’

Next week, Alya becomes suspicious of Joel’s behaviour when he drops a receipt from a jewellers, and spots him driving off with another woman.
